final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS acl_igm FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS mean_igm FROM per_patient), deviations AS (SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.acl_igm, pp.acl_igm - o.mean_igm AS deviation FROM per_patient AS pp CROSS JOIN overall AS o), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess_deviation FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess_deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
